t: This is Ironmonger Row Baths, a Grade II listed building in St Luke's, near Old Street. It was built in two phases. The first, a public wash house and slipper baths, opened in 1931. The second, opened in 1938, added the main swimming pool, a children's pool and Victorian-style Turkish baths. The architect was Alfred Cross, who lived from 1858 to 1932.
